title: A Sight To Sea Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: This luxury three-bedroom penthouse sleeping 8 has been renovated to the studs. Gourmet kitchen, king primary, marble bathrooms and designer furnishings throughout! Stunning gulf views and sunsets from the balcony over Seaside Amphitheater!
description_expanded: Description25 Central Square Unit 305 over the Seaside, AmphitheaterKING, QUEEN, TWIN BUNK, SLEEPER SOFA; SLEEPS 8 Designer Living with Unmatched Gulf ViewsThe main living level welcomes you with a beautifully appointed living room featuring all-new designer furnishings, a large wall-mounted Smart TV, and a queen sleeper sofa to accommodate additional guests. Thoughtfully designed for both comfort and style, this space flows seamlessly into the dining area, where an elegant chandelier anchors a table that comfortably seats six.Just beyond, step onto your private outdoor balcony—one of the home’s true highlights. With bar seating for four, this is the perfect spot to enjoy evening wine while watching spectacular Seaside sunsets and sweeping Gulf views. From this vantage point, guests can also listen to live concerts from the Seaside Amphitheater or enjoy front-row views of Fourth of July and New Year’s Eve fireworks. A convenient half bath and a full-size stacked washer and dryer tucked into a laundry closet complete the main level.Upstairs Bedrooms Designed for Comfort & PrivacyUpstairs, the second floor features three well-appointed bedrooms, each offering its own sense of retreat. The elegant primary suite includes a king bed, vaulted ceilings, and stunning Gulf views framed by a charming bay window. Custom built-in closets and cabinetry provide ample storage, while a large mounted Smart TV adds modern comfort. The spa-inspired en-suite bathroom showcases marble finishes, a single vanity with a lighted mirror, and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower with an oversized rain shower head.Down the hall, the second bedroom features a custom-built twin bunk and access to a private balcony. This hidden gem offers bar seating for two and breathtaking, unobstructed views of the Coleman Pavilion and the Gulf—an unforgettable perch above Seaside’s iconic beachfront. A shared hall bathroom serves this level, complete with a marble single vanity, lighted mirror, and a glass-enclosed marble tub and shower combination.The third bedroom offers a peaceful queen retreat with a custom built-in closet featuring generous drawers and storage, a large mounted Smart TV, and its own private balcony. Furnished with bistro-style bar seating for two, this balcony provides the perfect private spot to enjoy morning coffee or unwind after a day at the beach.Together, these thoughtfully designed spaces create a refined yet relaxed Seaside, Florida vacation rental, ideal for families and groups seeking luxury, location, and unforgettable Gulf views.* 5 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer; 3 night Fall; 2 night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURES:1,115 square feet of thoughtfully designed interior living space Seaside Beach access at Coleman PavilionThree private balconies, ideal for indoor–outdoor livingStunning Gulf and sunset viewsCoffee and espresso maker for effortless morningsElegant marble bathrooms featuring lighted mirrors and rain showersPeacock Alley linens throughout the home, offering fresh, luxurious towels and sheetsAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fully equipped fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities provided upon arrivalTwo parking passes included for two-bedroom homes; shared parking available in four designated spaces at 25 Central on a first-come, first-served basis; overflow parking available at the Lyceum commercial shared lot or nearby public parkingNo pets permitted
